what: The name wordmark (two words) in the header row is fully visible, then after 2s every letter except the initials disappears in an 18ms sequence over .2s (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), leaving initials like ”H A”. Hovering the wordmark re-lights the folded letters in the same sequence, and on release it folds again.

options.[data-fx-part=letter]: Characters to fold (children) — --i in style gives the order (not applied to the initial letter). SVG tspan works too
options.dur · each: Length of one character (sec, default .2) · stagger gap (sec, default .018)

from.where: shared (index·detail) .hj-logo (header wordmark of two words — only the first letter remains)

note: With reduced motion it starts collapsed (it does not expand on hover). The original collapses only on first open and does not collapse again after a swup transition, since the header row stays as is.
